goalZh: 会说旅行要带的东西,用 need + 名词问要不要带
canDoZh: 能列出旅行要带的东西,问朋友自己需不需要带某样东西

newItems.noteZh: suit + case,复合词重音在前 SUIT-case;ui 读 /uː/。
一般用复数,和 glasses 一样;复合词重音在前 SUN-glasses。
一般用复数,和 pants、jeans 一样;sh 读 /ʃ/,嘴唇往前突,不要读成 s。
sun + screen,重音在前;scr 三个辅音连读,中间不加元音。
swim + suit,重音在前 SWIM-suit;男生的泳裤也可以叫 swimsuit。
重音在后 ho-TEL,和中文“酒店”的节奏不同;at the hotel(在酒店)。
ow 读 /aʊ/,后面的 el 很轻;复数 towels。
美式说 vacation,英式多说 holiday;v 上齿轻咬下唇;重音在 -CA-。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Hey, Lei! Are you ready for LA?
lines.zh: (出发前一晚,伊森和磊视频)嘿,磊!去洛杉矶准备好了吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes! Look, this is my suitcase. It's a carry-on.
lines.zh: 好了!你看,这是我的行李箱,一个登机箱。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Is that a coat? You don't need a coat! It's 75 degrees here.
lines.zh: 那是厚外套吗?你不用带外套!这儿七十五度。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: OK, no coat. So what do I need?
lines.zh: 好吧,不带外套。那我要带什么?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Sunglasses, shorts, and sunscreen. It's really sunny.
lines.zh: 太阳镜、短裤和防晒霜。太阳很大。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: And a swimsuit for the beach!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: But I can't swim! Do I need a towel, too?
lines.zh: 可我不会游泳!还要带毛巾吗?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: No, the hotel has towels. It's a vacation, man!
lines.zh: 不用,酒店有毛巾。这是度假,兄弟!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: OK. Sunglasses, shorts, sunscreen, and a swimsuit. That's it!
lines.zh: 好。太阳镜、短裤、防晒霜,还有泳衣。就这些!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Cool. And take a lot of pictures! See you in LA!
lines.zh: 酷。记得多拍照!洛杉矶见!

questions.prompt: 伊森为什么说磊不用带厚外套?
questions.explainZh: You don't need a coat! It's 75 degrees here.(这儿七十五度。)
No, the hotel has towels.(酒店有毛巾。)

questions.prompt: 磊最后决定带哪些东西?
options: 太阳镜、短裤、防晒霜和泳衣
questions.explainZh: Sunglasses, shorts, sunscreen, and a swimsuit. That's it!

grammar.titleZh: need + 名词:I need… / You don't need… / Do I need…?
grammar.bodyZh: 说需要什么,用 need + 名词(第 4 单元学过):I need sunglasses.;不需要:You don't need a coat.;问别人:Do I need a towel? — No, you don't. / Yes, you do.。need 后面直接跟名词,中间不加 to;need to + 动词原形(需要做某事)下一课学。

examples.text: You don't need a coat. It's 75 degrees here!
examples.zh: 你不用带外套。这儿七十五度!

examples.text: Do I need a towel? — No, the hotel has towels.
examples.zh: 要带毛巾吗?——不用,酒店有。

grammar.bodyZh: 两个词合成一个词时,重音一般落在前一个词上:SUNglasses、SUNscreen、SUITcase、SWIMsuit,和第 7 单元的 MOvie theater 一样。重音放错(说成 sun-GLASS-es),美国人可能一下听不懂。carry-on 也是重音在前:CA-rry-on。sunglasses、shorts 和 glasses、jeans 一样,一般用复数。

examples.text: This is my suitcase. It's a carry-on.
examples.zh: 这是我的行李箱,一个登机箱。
